selected_work: R89 hosted vertex-shader input-signature contract smoke for R88 FVF blend-weight/index layouts.
summary: R89 hosted vertex-shader input-signature semantic smoke completed after an evidence-backed link repair. Backend Conversion Gate 36508328443 failed because D3DReflect referenced IID_ID3D11ShaderReflection while the smoke target omitted dxguid.lib. ATTEMPT 2 repair commit aac1839f6af310c2e4b34388f3ff4032a3a756a2 added dxguid.lib to cmake.toml and generated CMakeLists.txt plus a source-graph guard. ATTEMPT 3 verified that exact repair SHA across Backend Conversion Gate, Build, OpenXR and HUD Inspector. Production renderer/runtime behavior was not changed by the repair.
evidence: Failure run 36508328443: Build DX11 input-signature semantic smoke failed with LNK2019 unresolved external symbol _IID_ID3D11ShaderReflection.
Job log proves dx11_input_signature_semantics compiled pipeline_translation.cpp/state_translation.cpp/test source and failed only at link; prior R87/R88 semantic smokes passed.
Repair commit aac1839f6af310c2e4b34388f3ff4032a3a756a2 adds dxguid.lib to cmake.toml and generated CMakeLists.txt, and verifies the link contract in tools/verify_dx11_source_graph.py.
Backend Conversion Gate 36509613920 PASS on exact repair SHA, including Verify DX11 source graph, Build DX11 input-signature semantic smoke and Run DX11 input-signature semantic smoke.
Build 36509617864 PASS on exact repair SHA.
OpenXR VR architecture 36509617873 PASS across all six jobs on exact repair SHA.
HUD Inspector 36509617857 PASS on exact repair SHA.
No Quest 3/VDXR, game execution, GPU input-layout creation/binding, or native D3D11 runtime validation was performed.

changes.result: Added dxguid.lib to dx11_input_signature_semantics link-libraries so D3DReflect resolves IID_ID3D11ShaderReflection.
Added generated dxguid.lib link entry for dx11_input_signature_semantics.
Added R89 link contract guard requiring dxguid.lib in generated and source-of-truth CMake graphs.

D3DFVF_XYZB3 | LASTBETA_UBYTE4 -> BLENDINDICES uint4 reflected signature

fail_closed: UBYTE4 BLENDINDICES descriptor paired with float4 BLENDINDICES HLSL must fail the reflected component-type contract

activation_gate.reason: R89 hosted reflection/ABI smoke and its link repair do not create or bind a D3D11 input layout/shader in the game runtime and do not prove Quest3/VDXR parity.

next_action: Keep NativeDrawPathActivationAllowed=false and shaderTranslationExact=false. The next bounded DX11 task should use the now-hosted-validated R88/R89 input contract to advance a non-routing input-layout object/probe or another narrowly scoped F19/F21 prerequisite, without claiming runtime parity. Exact-build Quest3/VDXR validation remains required.

failure_context.root_cause: D3DReflect interface IID lives in dxguid.lib; smoke target omitted that GUID provider.
